title: Efficiency (কর্মদক্ষতা)
placement: Book page 121, section 4.8 কর্মদক্ষতা (Efficiency): next to the two forms of the formula (কর্মদক্ষতা = কাজের পরিমাণ / প্রদত্ত শক্তি × 100%) and the উদাহরণ of the 1000 W motor that lifts 100 kg up 10 m in 15 s.
description: Efficiency (কর্মদক্ষতা, page 121, 4.8) as the book's worked example built as a real machine. On the roof of a building going up (a concrete slab with a yellow-and-black edge, rusty bars on the columns, cement bags and drums; brick floors and blue scaffolding with a green net below; sand, bricks, an orange mixer and a blue truck on the street 10 m down; colourful houses, trees, a yellow tower crane and a blue sky round about) a 1000 W electric motor, fed from a battery through a red (+) and a blue (−) cable, turns a steel worm; the worm turns a bronze worm wheel (20 : 1), a 14-tooth pinion on its shaft turns a 42-tooth gear, and a yellow drum on that shaft winds a rope that runs over a pulley on a jib and lifts a 100 kg pallet of red bricks 10 m. Every tooth is an involute tooth and the gears turn at their exact ratios, in mesh. The panel is one action, one result, one rule. Step ১ "সুইচ চালু করো" (the big button, or a tap on the battery's switch, ringed by the same numbered badge): bright beads of current run out along the red cable and back along the blue, the battery's display counts P = 1000 W and t, a height gauge on the view shows the load rising, and the wasted energy leaves visibly: heat shimmers off the motor and its copper windings (seen through a window in its body) glow, sparks and a warm glow where the teeth rub, purple rings of sound spread from the gears. The result line is a flow diagram that fills as it runs: প্রদত্ত শক্তি (P × t) in, splitting into কাজের পরিমাণ (mgh, on the load) and শক্তির অপচয় (heat in the motor, heat by friction, sound: the split marked approximate, the total exactly input − work). The rule is the book's formula with the numbers (both forms, switched with ⇄); each term is a button that rings its part of the machine. Three motors as the row of words: the book's (15 s, 9,800 J of 15,000 J, 5,200 J wasted, 65.3%), with oiled gears (14 s, 70%) and with worn gears (20 s, 49%); once two are found the rule adds the book's power plant (30%). "উদাহরণ" opens the book's worked example as a sheet: the question in the book's words with steppers for P, t, m and h, the answer line by line (কাজের পরিমাণ = 100 × 9.8 × 10 J = 9,800 J, প্রদত্ত শক্তি = 1000 × 15 J = 15,000 J, শক্তির অপচয় = 5,200 J, কর্মদক্ষতা = 65.3%, marked বইয়ের উত্তর), a warning when the numbers would need 100% or more, and a button that runs those numbers on the machine. Test tab: 5 tap questions on frozen scenes (the efficiency and the waste from labels on the scene, the energy supplied from the motor's power and time, where the heat comes from, what oiling does, the power plant's 30%). Phone-first, Bangla.
